description: This file defines the CanvasSchemeHandler class, which implements WKURLSchemeHandler to serve local files over custom URL schemes within a macOS application. It handles URL requests, resolves file paths within a session directory, and returns appropriate HTML or file data, including fallback pages and security checks.

classes.name: CanvasSchemeHandler
classes.description: A class that handles custom URL scheme requests for serving session-specific local files within a WebView.

methods.name: webView(_:start:)
methods.description: Starts serving a URL scheme task by resolving the URL, determining the content and MIME type, and providing the data back to the web view.

methods.name: webView(_:stop:)
methods.description: Stops the URL scheme task. Currently a no-op.

methods.name: response(for:)
methods.description: Generates a CanvasResponse containing the MIME type and data for the requested URL, handling session validation and fallback to scaffold or error pages as needed.

methods.name: resolveFileURL(sessionRoot:isDirectory:requestPath:)
methods.description: Resolves the file URL within the session directory based on the request path, handling index files and directory traversal.

methods.name: resolveIndex(in:)
methods.description: Finds index.html or index.htm within a directory to serve as a default.

methods.name: isFileURL(_:withinDirectory:)
methods.description: Checks whether a file URL resides within the specified directory to prevent directory traversal.

methods.name: html(_:title:)
methods.description: Creates a CanvasResponse with a simple HTML page containing the provided body and title.

methods.name: welcomePage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Generates a welcome page informing the user to create an index.html in the session root.

methods.name: scaffoldPage(sessionRoot:)
methods.description: Provides a scaffold page, either from bundled resources or a fallback welcome page.

methods.name: loadBundledResourceData(relativePath:)
methods.description: Loads resource data encoded in the app bundle based on a relative path.

methods.name: textEncodingName(forMimeType:)
methods.description: Returns the text encoding name for a given MIME type.
